scope_limit: Ideal-experiment admission gate only, one favorable condition (spacing multiplier 8, stage length 180, observation noise 2.6% of mean discharge). The exact current complete parameter vector is always present among three candidates; process covariance fixed at process_2; each stage excludes its first five days from identification scoring. The spacing multiplier also rescales the truth trajectory and low noise lowers both generated and assumed observation error (well-specified), by design of the best-case condition. Results establish only whether the full IMM can identify a known truth under ideal conditions; they do not establish behavior at other spacings, budgets, noise levels, scenarios, or real basins.
